description: The inputs a figure needs that the airplane's profile lacks, by name, so the app asks for them where the figure would be (the owner, 2026-11-09): the legs their cruise speed and burn; the fuel totals also the start, taxi and takeoff allowance; the glide its glide ratio; the climb its climb speed, sea-level rate and service ceiling; the descent its indicated speed and fuel flow; a weight and balance its loading envelope and its own empty weight and moment; takeoff and landing their charts. ["airplane"] with no airplane.

profile.description: The airplane (airplane_figures' profile); null for no airplane.

missing.description: The inputs' names in order: a figure's key (taxi_fuel_gal, glide_ratio ...), a table (loading, takeoff, landing), or airplane.
